name: Deep Learning 1 — Practice Lab (TensorFlow Basics, MNIST)
description: Guided learner workspace for the first lab of a beginner Deep Learning course (freshmen, 2×45 min): history of neural networks, core machine-learning concepts, and a hands-on MNIST digit classifier in TensorFlow 2 / Keras 3 — data prep, Sequential model demo, closing task, differentiated homework.
